description: T-4164: does a filter on an inner field rank per parent or over the whole field, and do subtotals and grand totals count the items it removes? Data!A1:C7 has Region, Product and Sales: East A 10, B 3, C 6 (19); West A 1, B 9, C 4 (14); the field totals are A 11, B 12, C 10 (33). Each sheet is one builder-v2 pivot at A3, rows Region then Product, Sum of Sales: ITop count top 1 on Product (per parent East A and West B; over the field B in both); IVal valueGreaterThan 5 on Product (per cell East A, C and West B; over the field every item); IPct percent top 50 on Product (per parent A and B; over the field B and A in both); OTop count top 1 on Region; SH0 Product C hidden, no subtotalHiddenItems; SH1T, SH1V and SH1L the ITop, IVal and a captionNotEqual A filter with subtotalHiddenItems 1; SH1H SH0 with subtotalHiddenItems 1. Pivot cells are in the sidecar's `pivots` section; Q!A1 makes the case scored.
